description: Token format for Triage assessment workflow

heart_attack.symptoms: crushing chest pain, ST elevation on the ambulance ECG

stroke.symptoms: facial droop, arm weakness, onset under 2 hours

notes: tokenId, version, notAfter, currentPlace, workflow_start_time are auto-populated
data fields can be overridden via -data command line argument
Use dataVariants with -variant argument to select specific patient scenarios
Without -variant, patient n presents with caseMix[(n - 1) mod its length]: a fixed emergency case mix, so a run
of ten patients brings two (a heart attack and a stroke) that triage sends straight to treatment
